item: The Wikidata QID link sits beside a keyword chip, never inside its button
summary: axe nested-interactive (serious, WCAG 4.1.2) on the Insights family chips: the keyword's QID link was inside the chip's button. kwLabelHtml with inButton now leaves the QID out (as inLink did) and the three button callers draw kwQidHtml after their closing tag; the link stays (row 178). axe on Insights at 1440, 768 and 390 px: 3 nested-interactive nodes per width before, none after.
